description: This file contains the implementation of the AuthService class, which provides authentication-related functionalities such as user registration and login in the backend of a Java Spring application.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Service class handling user registration and login functionalities for authentication.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user, throwing an exception if the email already exists in the database.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user based on email and password, returning appropriate responses or throwing exceptions.
